Failing Teeth? Replace Today

Living with a failing tooth can be a constant source of anxiety. Whether it’s a cracked molar that hurts when you chew, or a front tooth that has been heavily filled and is now breaking down, the uncertainty is draining.

Many patients come to us believing their situation is hopeless or fearing a long period without teeth. However, modern implant dentistry allows us to transition you from a failing tooth to a fixed, beautiful replacement often in a much shorter timeframe than you might expect.

At Dental Implants London, we focus on saving smiles. If a tooth is beyond repair, we plan for restoration options, including immediate implant placement where appropriate.

Common Signs of Failing Teeth

Recurring Infections

If you have had multiple abscesses or need frequent antibiotics for the same tooth, the root system may be compromised.

Deep Cracks

Cracks extending below the gum line often cannot be fixed with fillings or crowns and may split the tooth entirely.

Failed Root Canals

Sometimes a treated tooth becomes re-infected or brittle over time. Implants offer a more predictable long-term solution.

Severe Mobility

A tooth that is loose due to gum disease or bone loss may need to be replaced to stop the spread of infection to adjacent teeth.

The Procedure

Immediate Implants: A Seamless Transition

In many cases, we can perform an Immediate Implant Placement. This involves carefully extracting the failing tooth and placing the titanium implant into the socket during the same appointment.

  • May reduce the number of surgical appointments needed.
  • Helps maintain the natural gum architecture.
  • Can reduce the degree of bone changes following extraction.
  • A temporary tooth may be provided where suitable.

Expert Care for Complex Cases

Removing a failing tooth and placing an implant simultaneously requires high-level surgical skill to ensure the bone is protected. Our surgeons are highly experienced in these complex "rescue" procedures.

We are CQC regulated and use state-of-the-art 3D CBCT scanning to map your nerve pathways and bone density before we even touch the tooth, supporting a high level of safety and precision in planning.

• CQC Regulated• Digital Planning• Gentle Dentistry

Don't Wait Until It Hurts

A failing tooth often causes damage to the surrounding bone the longer it is left. Early intervention is key to a simpler, more affordable treatment.
